reviews.comment: Professor Cortez is a great option for ENGL 210. She gives good feedback on rough drafts and is very willing to answer questions and provide guidance on how to best complete assignments. There are a lot of papers, as this is a writing class, but they are spread out and if you stay on top of them, it isn't a hard class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Cortez is so sweet and caring, and makes an effort to build relationships with the students even when fully online. She is very understanding and gives extensions on papers. The weekly homework is not that hard, and the bigger papers are very doable. She takes a lot of time to give thorough feedback on drafts. Highly recommend!

I absolutely loved professor Cortez!!! Take her if you can, she is super understanding and grades pretty easily if you do your part. She takes a while to grade but she is so sweet and responds to email really quickly. I hate English but this class I really enjoyed.

She provides the textbook for free, weekly assignments don't take much time or effort, essay topics are enjoyable enough, and she grades nicely. She's extremely understanding if you ask for extensions.
This class is easy. You will have to write some stuff every couple of weeks, then have one big project at the end of the semester. If you do these things, you will do well.
